output.sql:
SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l
JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
WHERE o.is_revenue
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
output.explanation: Ranks product categories by net revenue (the sum of order line net amounts) across all dates, highest first. Only orders flagged as revenue (is_revenue) are counted. Shipping fees are not included, since they aren't tied to a product category.
